title: P-037 A2.2-D: the door-registration epoch, frozen before implementation
frozen_at: frozen by the commit carrying formal note 10.6.14 (docs and a test, no implementation) and tightened by the commit that added production_diff_gate and measurement_policy; a ruling, not a measurement

closes.closed_by: A2.2-S, evidence f621400 (state=accepted, is_evidence=true) landed in the note by fa92c05, integrated at 6f9c373
closes.why_closed: A2.2-D changes the measurement instrument itself (both OwnIR doors register the guarded vocabulary), so the a2 baseline R is by definition not a baseline of the new instrument

predecessors.role: historical predecessors of this epoch: not a baseline, not a before side and not a control of any a2d comparison; none is retaken
predecessors.environment: P037_A2_MEASUREMENT_M1, retired with the epoch; not a control of M2

treatment.what: door registration: `guarded_facts` (per functions[] record) and `guarded_functions[]` (top-level carrier) become KNOWN, fail-loud vocabulary at both OwnIR doors, validated at load against spec/OwnIR.md 5.2-5.3 with matching refusal categories on both engines, and still semantically inert: no lowerer, summary or verdict reads them
treatment.granularity: the smallest git-addressable units that contain the two doors today (ownlang/ownir.py holds load(), the Python door, beside the Python lowering; rust/crates/own-ir/ is the Rust strict door and model; spec/ holds the vocabulary text); they stay the technical units of the closure, and the D production diff inside them is bounded mechanically by production_diff_gate below, not by review and not by line numbers

production_diff_gate.what: the mechanical boundary of the D production diff inside the treatment units: applied between a reference (T_D once the R_D manifest names it; the integration head until then) and a head; verdict IDENTICAL, WITHIN_ALLOWLIST or VIOLATION; anything the gate cannot decide is REFUSED, never a pass
production_diff_gate.reference_rule: against the integration head every head before T_D must be IDENTICAL and T_D itself must be IDENTICAL; against T_D the D treatment head must be IDENTICAL or WITHIN_ALLOWLIST; the cumulative driver refuses a D after run whose treatment head is not

python.rule: top-level definitions compared as AST with positions ignored and docstrings included; every existing top-level definition other than the mutable ones must be structurally identical to the reference; a new top-level definition is allowed only if its name is registered in registered_helpers as a door-only helper (a function or a module-level constant, never a class) and does not exist in the reference; nothing may be removed; hunks and line numbers play no part

rust.rule: src/strict.rs may change freely; in src/lib.rs only the named model items may change and only items registered in registered_new_items may appear, every other item compared token-wise with plain comments dropped and outer doc comments kept; the frozen files are byte-identical by git object id; a production file the policy does not cover is a violation when added and a refusal when found in the reference; tests/ are controls and move freely

spec.rule: the live sidecar contracts may change; every other tracked file under spec/ is byte-identical by git object id

production_diff_gate.registration_rule: registered_helpers and registered_new_items are the only fields of this gate a D treatment commit may extend, by name, in the same commit as the definition; every other field is pinned by tests/test_p037_a2d_epoch.py

instrument.note: the extractor, the sidecar's producer, joins the instrument in this epoch and is frozen; the doors are carved out of their roots as the treatment; the instrument closure of a2d is the roots minus the carve-outs and must be identical at T_D, R_D and every after head

orchestrator.rule: evidence orchestration, outside the instrument closure, pinned per run by --orchestrator-commit to a reviewed commit from a clean checkout

qualification: an isolated pinned toolchain (CPython, .NET SDK, rustc/cargo) provisioned by a recipe whose sha256 is recorded in the R_D manifest and retained outside the repository, as M1's was
the execution profile (scripts/p037_evidence.py profile) captured before R_D and equal on every record of the epoch; a record whose profile differs is not eligible
one measured workspace checkout root for T_D, R_D and every after run of the epoch (path-sensitive fields, #364)
the environment id recorded on every record of the epoch and required equal by every comparison; a2 records carry none and are ineligible by construction
environment.m1_rule: M1 takes nothing for this epoch and is not a control of M2; T, R and S are not retaken

order: freeze (this record and formal note 10.6.14; docs, no implementation)

tooling: p037_evidence.py learns the a2d closure (roots minus carve-outs), records the epoch and the environment id (taken from this record, never from an operator string) on every take, and refuses cross-epoch or cross-environment comparisons; the cumulative driver reads measurement_policy.fact_diff from this record as a closed enum and applies production_diff_gate to the treatment head as eligibility; CI green; no door, extractor or spec line moves

T_D: a terminal-green descendant of the integration head, the freeze and the tooling whose doors are byte-identical to 6f9c373's (production_diff_gate IDENTICAL); named by the R_D manifest, never by this record
R_D: the four governed baseline takes at T_D on M2, verified fresh at T_D, committed evidence-only with a manifest naming T_D, the environment id, the profile and the recipe sha256

D treatment: the door registration on both doors with its validation-ledger controls and the extended inertness control (a vocabulary-violating sidecar refused at both doors with the same category; a valid contradictory sidecar still moves no layer); only the treatment paths and tests move, and only within production_diff_gate against T_D (a door-only helper or a new model item only by registering its name in this record in the same commit)
D after: the governed cumulative measurement at the D head against R_D on M2 by the pinned orchestrator; accepted only as below; then Phase B, in an epoch of its own

claims_preregistered.facts: UNCHANGED on every document (the extractor is instrument now; a moved fact document is a failed claim, not a licensed movement)
claims_preregistered.mos: UNCHANGED on both engines, per document
claims_preregistered.verdicts: UNCHANGED on both engines at level verdict and level all, per file
claims_preregistered.engines_agree: Python and Rust agree on lowered, summaries and verdicts before and after, and on the verdict snapshots
claims_preregistered.fail_loud: both doors refuse a sidecar outside the frozen vocabulary at load, with the same refusal category, and the validation ledger replays it; both doors still accept and preserve a valid sidecar unchanged

measurement_policy.rule: read by the cumulative driver as a closed enum (FACT_DIFF_POLICIES in scripts/p037_door_diff_gate.py, mirrored by the measurement tooling): unchanged means every fact document identical between before and after and an empty classified fact diff; allowed_surfaces is the a2 policy (movement confined to the allowed surfaces) and is not this epoch's; a missing or unknown value is REFUSED; the prose of claims_preregistered is for people and is never parsed

comparison_rules: no a2d record is compared with an a2 record: different instrument, different environment; the tooling refuses it, this record forbids it
before and after of every a2d comparison are taken on M2 with one profile in one workspace root

the population of a2d is re-frozen at T_D (the tracked .cs under the corpus and repo-tree roots at T_D; the repo tree now includes frontend/roslyn/OwnSharp.Oracle/Program.cs); it is not T's population and is not compared with it
the old epoch's evidence stays in docs/evidence as history and is neither edited nor revalidated by a2d tooling
